description: What workout can I do with this time, this gear, and this body? GetFit's coach builds a complete session that fits the minutes, uses only the equipment they have, and steers around anything they want to avoid. Give the person the whole workout in the chat — warm-up, every exercise with sets, reps, rest and effort — and read out the safety_notes. The workout is also posted to GetFit's public Explore page (no personal details), and `link` opens it in GetFit, where the Player runs it with timers and rest countdowns. Inputs (all optional): focus, minutes, equipment, avoid, level, goal, intensity. Example: {"focus":"legs","minutes":30,"equipment":"from home","avoid":["knees"]}.

avoid.description: Body parts or movements to avoid: "knees", "lower back", "jumping".

equipment.description: What they have: a preset (none | dumbbells | hotel_gym | full_gym), free text ("a couple of dumbbells", "from home"), or a list. Nothing named → bodyweight.

focus.description: What to train, in plain words: "legs", "upper body", "full body", "core".

minutes.description: Time available, warm-up included (5-120). Treated as a hard ceiling. Default 30.

name: build_workout
title: Build a workout
